subject: Vendor enrollment: PO authorization flow & pay-cycle blocker
messages:
From: Adam Levin <adam.levin@novus-retail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: AP Operations <ap-ops@novus-retail.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment: PO authorization flow & payment rails

Hi Neha —

We're finalizing vendor onboarding for Redwood and ran into a couple of blockers on our side before we can issue the first PO. Can you confirm the following so our AP team can complete enrollment and kick the first payment?

1) Legal entity and invoicing name we should expect on your invoices (full legal name + VAT/Tax ID).
2) Who in your org is authorized for PO acceptance vs invoices for payment (we need a PO acceptance contact + invoice submission contact).
3) Does Redwood accept Net-30 via ACH/virtual card only or are wire instructions required for initial setup?
4) We prefer PO acknowledgement via webhook to our integration endpoint — can you confirm you can send an automated PO ack (200/accepted) and the field that ties an invoice to a PO (your invoice XML/CSV field name)?

We have to cut a payment on our April 15th paycycle and need vendor provisioning completed by EOD April 8 to hit internal timelines.

Thanks,
Adam
Adam Levin
AP Integration Lead, Novus Retail
ap-ops@novus-retail.com

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_template.pdf (stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Adam Levin <adam.levin@novus-retail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: PO authorization flow & payment rails

Hi Adam —

Thanks — looping in Jordan (finance) and Marissa (ops) to confirm details. Quick answers inline below and attached a short checklist and a mapping workbook that should help the webhook/invoice field bit.

1) Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Invoice remit name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - US EIN: 12-3456789
   - VAT/Tax (EU customers): Redwood Inference EMEA Ltd (VAT: GB999999999) — let us know which entity you need on file.

2) PO vs Invoice contacts:
   - PO acceptance (sales/contracts canonical): Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com)
   - Invoice submission & AP point: Jordan Blake (invoices@redwood.inference.com) — Jordan can accept invoice emails and secure SFTP/webhook endpoints.

3) Payment rails:
   - We accept ACH and virtual card in the US. For vendors requiring wire, we can provide wire details but need an initial ACH test transaction to validate bank details in some banks.

4) PO acknowledgement/webhook:
   - We can emit PO-ACK webhooks to your endpoint. Primary correlation field is "po_reference" in our invoice XML/CSV (we included an example in the workbook).

I've attached: RI_AP_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.pdf and Novus_PO_Authorization_Map.xlsx — the latter has the expected webhook payload and sample CSV header.

Jordan/Marissa — can you confirm the earliest date we can provide an integration endpoint and whether we should request Novus to push a test PO via the webhook before April 8?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: RI_AP_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.pdf, Novus_PO_Authorization_Map.xlsx (stubs)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Adam Levin <adam.levin@novus-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: PO authorization flow & payment rails

Adam / Neha —

Quick technical notes from finance:

- We've provisioned an invoices@redwood.inference.com mailbox that can receive invoice PDFs and CSVs. If Novus prefers API ingestion, we can enable the webhook listener by Thursday (2027-04-08) but we'll need Novus to send a signed test PO payload to the staging URL so we can validate signatures and mapping.

- Correlation: Jordan confirmed our invoice parser looks for "po_reference" (string) and "line_item_id" for granular matching. If you send a PDF only, please include the PO number on the first page and in the filename as: PO_<po_number>_Novus.pdf.

- Payment method: We can pay Net-30 via ACH or virtual card. For wires, we need W-9 (US) or bank letter + proof of account. Wire payments incur a one-time manual setup that may miss the April 15 paycycle unless Novus completes onboarding by EOD April 8 and provides bank proof.

Action items for Novus (Adam):
1) Confirm which Redwood legal entity to use on the Novus vendor record (US vs EMEA).
2) Send signed test PO to staging webhook by 2027-04-08 17:00 PDT (staging URL in attached workbook).
3) If wiring, upload bank proof and tax docs now (W-9 or equivalent).

Neha/Marissa — if we get the test PO and docs on Thursday we can include Novus in the April 15 paycycle, otherwise they'll roll to the April 29 paycycle.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
invoices@redwood.inference.com

Thanks for the clarity. Novus will:

- Send a signed test PO to the staging webhook by Thu 04/08 (Adam to confirm signing method — we use HMAC-signed payloads; will send sample header).

I'll upload the docs and ping when the test PO is out. If the webhook handshake is successful, please confirm by reply and we'll expect the April 15 paycycle.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we'll aim to hit the Thursday deadline.
